paragon.note: Board/glyph selection and all 320 taken node positions verified live from Mobalytics (p4wnyhof, BLAZING Torment variant, updated Sep 16, 2026) via the site's own interactive Paragon Board widget (React/DOM props: id, type, isSelected - not present in the page's initial JSON payload). board_width (21), glyph_socket_index and start_node_index were derived from each node's real position (index = (y-1)*21 + (x-1), verified against the one board where an independent prior source also had a value at the exact same index). Node rarity comes from the widget's own node-type classification; normal/magic/rare node names are derived directly from their icon filenames (e.g. "5-willpower-active.webp" -> "+5 Willpower"). The 4 legendary nodes' exact names are DATA UNAVAILABLE: their icons only reuse the board's own generic icon, and this session's hover-based tooltip automation could not reach them (off-screen in the widget's pan/zoom state) - everything else about them (board, position, index, rarity=legendary, taken=true) is verified.

key_items.name: Harlequin Crest
key_items.note: Gain +6 Rank to all Skills. Mythic Unique. 2 rune sockets.

key_items.name: Elegy
key_items.note: Blazing Scream is now an Archfiend Skill and deals [30-50]% increased damage. Blazing Scream gains the Skull Splitter Variant for free and the Lesser Demon skulls deal the same damage as the main skull. Unique. Ranks to Blazing Scream; 1 gem socket (Ruby).

key_items.name: Moloch's Beating Flame
key_items.note: Hellfire Skills deal [20-30]% increased damage for every Skill you have Empowered by Volatility. Casting a Volatility Empowered Skill increases your Core Stats by 5% for 10 seconds, up to 50%. Unique. Kullean-transfigured with Undying Aspect — don't miss this or the build falls apart. 1 gem socket (Splinter of Sin).

key_items.name: Temerity
key_items.note: Effects that Heal you beyond 100% Life grant you Barrier equal to [80-100]% of the overhealed amount that lasts for 8 seconds. You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life. Unique. 2 rune sockets. Generates a Barrier from Healing (pairs with the amulet's Undying Aspect).

key_items.name: The Eightfold Idol
key_items.note: Blazing Scream leaves Sigil of Subversion Shadow or Lava trails behind. You deal [60-80]% increased Abyss or Hellfire Skill damage to enemies on Sigil of Subversion trails based on their type. Unique. Ranks to Sigil of Subversion; 1 gem socket (Splinter of the Black Soulstone).

key_items.name: Infernal Homunculus
key_items.note: Your Archfiend Skills deal [80-110]% increased damage and casting any Archfiend Skill activates all their Lesser Demon Upgrades for free with 200% longer durations. Unique. Ranks to Demonology skills; 1 gem socket (Ruby).

key_aspects.name: Aspect of Diabolical Armor
key_aspects.note: Demonform grants 20% Damage Reduction plus an additional [1.0-1.5]% for 5 seconds any time you take Fire damage, up to [10-15]%. Chest armor. 2 gem sockets (Sapphire).

key_aspects.name: Aspect of Ignition
key_aspects.note: Skills empowered by Volatility deal an additional 60% increased damage and you have a [50.0-70.0]% chance for Volatility to persist on casting an empowered Skill. Gloves.

key_aspects.name: Embattled Aspect
key_aspects.note: Fortify's Drain Rate is increased by [150-200]%. Boots. Use Hellhound's Sabatons until swapping over to Metamorphosis (author swapped around Tier 6).

key_aspects.name: Aspect of Scorching Heat
key_aspects.note: Your Hellfire Skills deal increased damage equal to [65-85]% of your Fire Resistance Damage Reduction. Ring 2. 1 gem socket (Splinter of Anguish).
